summary: Blue Lake Lookout Tower in Sabine Parish near Ebarb, torn down per the Wikipedia list; all three sources agree on the parish. No build, staffing or site record found.

facts.status_note: Torn down, according to the Wikipedia list; no source describes the site today.

events.note: Wikipedia list marks the tower torn down; the list gives no date

evidence.supports: tower named Blue Lake Lookout Tower
Central US Lookouts index lists BLUE LAKE
parish given with the Blue Lake entry is Sabine Parish
TopoZone lists Blue Lake Lookout Tower in its Sabine County tower list
TopoZone gives the USGS map name Beech Bayou
the list is for Sabine County
1915 funds for fire protection work allowing the hiring of lookout watchmen or patrolmen
evidence.quote: In 1915 funds were directed for fire protection work allowing the hiring of lookout watchmen or patrolmen.

evidence.supports: first steel fire tower built near Bogalusa in 1922
evidence.quote: In 1922 the first steel fire tower was built near Bogalusa on Great Southern Lumber Company land.

evidence.supports: second tower built near Urania in 1923
evidence.quote: In 1923 the second tower was built near Urania
By 1943 thirty-nine fire towers had been built and by 1950 the number had increased to fifty-six.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Wikipedia list gives parish, nearest town, coordinates and only the note 'Torn down.'; Central US Lookouts and TopoZone agree on the parish and map name. No build, design, height, staffing, fire or access information in any source read. Coordinates in the record match the list. The Ebarb Wikipedia page was read but its lead did not come through cleanly, so it is not cited. No photos found.
